description: Iowa SNAP helps eligible households buy groceries with an EBT card. Apply through Iowa HHS and complete the household interview.
introduction: Iowa SNAP helps eligible households buy groceries with an EBT card. Apply through Iowa HHS and complete the household interview.

sections.who: Iowa HHS reviews residency, income, household size and eligible citizenship or immigration status. Allowable expenses affect the benefit calculation.
sections.get: Approved households receive food benefits on EBT. Iowa returned to federal SNAP food-purchase guidelines in July 2026; earlier descriptions of Iowa-only food restrictions are outdated.
sections.docs: Prepare identification, household details, pay records, housing and utility costs, and relevant childcare or medical expenses. You can submit the initial application before gathering every record.
sections.apply:
1. Use the Iowa HHS Services Portal, visit a local HHS office, or use the paper form linked in the state’s application instructions. Sign the application and save confirmation.

  2. Follow the telephone-interview notice. If you miss the appointment, contact HHS to reschedule and send requested evidence by its deadline.
sections.after: The decision notice states eligibility, benefit amount and certification period. Follow reporting and renewal instructions. Keep your EBT PIN private; HHS does not ask for it by text or telephone.
sections.sources:

faqs: Do I need every document before applying?
No. Submit the initial signed application, then provide the evidence HHS requests.
Did Iowa restrict which foods SNAP can buy?
The state returned to federal purchase guidelines in July 2026. Use current HHS guidance.
